svg.title: Continuous streaming: four-clock external latency
svg.text: First input edge to first output edge: 4 clocks; steady state accepts one input and one output per clock.
Actual XSim VCD, seed 1. Values sampled immediately before each rising edge; buses shown in hexadecimal.
Transfer markers = resetn & valid & ready. This sampled display does not prove analog setup/hold timing.
